I'll define neurotoxicity as descendants of "Peripheral nerve disease" (4117779) and cardiotoxicity as descendants of cardiomyopathy/heart failure/arrhythmia. Now let me run the full analysis in one query: per chemo class, cohort of lung-cancer patients with first exposure to a drug in that class, and 12-month incidence of each toxicity after index.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH lung_pts AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS dx_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor la ON co.condition_concept_id = la.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE la.ancestor_concept_id = 443388
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
classes(class_id, class_name) AS (
  SELECT 21603747,'Platinum compounds' UNION ALL
  SELECT 21603722,'Taxanes' UNION ALL
  SELECT 21601446,'Vinca alkaloids' UNION ALL
  SELECT 21601421,'Antimetabolites' UNION ALL
  SELECT 21601388,'Alkylating agents' UNION ALL
  SELECT 21603728,'Cytotoxic antibiotics'
),
class_drugs AS (
  SELECT c.class_id, c.class_name, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_cid
  FROM classes c
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = c.class_id
),
-- first exposure per patient per class, restricted to lung cancer patients and on/after dx
class_index AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, cd.class_id, cd.class_name, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN class_drugs cd ON de.drug_concept_id = cd.drug_cid
  JOIN lung_pts lp ON lp.person_id = de.person_id
  GROUP BY de.person_id, cd.class_id, cd.class_name
)
SELECT class_name, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS n_patients
FROM class_index
GROUP BY class_name
ORDER BY n_patients DESC;

Good, I have per-class cohorts. Now let me compute the 12-month toxicity incidence for each class in a single query.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH lung_pts AS (
  SELECT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor la ON co.condition_concept_id = la.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE la.ancestor_concept_id = 443388
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
classes(class_id, class_name) AS (
  SELECT 21603747,'Platinum compounds' UNION ALL
  SELECT 21603722,'Taxanes' UNION ALL
  SELECT 21601446,'Vinca alkaloids' UNION ALL
  SELECT 21601421,'Antimetabolites' UNION ALL
  SELECT 21601388,'Alkylating agents' UNION ALL
  SELECT 21603728,'Cytotoxic antibiotics'
),
class_drugs AS (
  SELECT c.class_id, c.class_name, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_cid
  FROM classes c
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = c.class_id
),
class_index AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, cd.class_name, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN class_drugs cd ON de.drug_concept_id = cd.drug_cid
  JOIN lung_pts lp ON lp.person_id = de.person_id
  GROUP BY de.person_id, cd.class_name
),
neuro AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS cid FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 4117779
),
cardio AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS cid FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (321319,316139,44784217,4047088)
),
neuro_events AS (
  SELECT ci.person_id, ci.class_name
  FROM class_index ci
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = ci.person_id
  JOIN neuro n ON co.condition_concept_id = n.cid
  WHERE co.condition_start_date > ci.index_date
    AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,365,ci.index_date)
  GROUP BY ci.person_id, ci.class_name
),
cardio_events AS (
  SELECT ci.person_id, ci.class_name
  FROM class_index ci
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = ci.person_id
  JOIN cardio c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.cid
  WHERE co.condition_start_date > ci.index_date
    AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,365,ci.index_date)
  GROUP BY ci.person_id, ci.class_name
)
SELECT ci.class_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ci.person_id) AS n_patients,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ne.person_id) AS n_neurotox,
       CAST(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT ne.person_id)/COUNT(DISTINCT ci.person_id) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS pct_neurotox,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ce.person_id) AS n_cardiotox,
       CAST(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT ce.person_id)/COUNT(DISTINCT ci.person_id) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS pct_cardiotox
FROM class_index ci
LEFT JOIN neuro_events ne ON ne.person_id=ci.person_id AND ne.class_name=ci.class_name
LEFT JOIN cardio_events ce ON ce.person_id=ci.person_id AND ce.class_name=ci.class_name
GROUP BY ci.class_name
ORDER BY n_patients DESC;
